layout: Episode 7 pack atlas, merged into npcs. Humanoid blocks (3 per band, rows down,left,right,up x cols stand,stepA,stepB,blink). No atlas `origin`: every frame uses the default bottom-centre [12,31]. npc_keeper is Nox (white hair pinned up, frost on the hem, ink on her right hand, a lamp); npc_keeper_mid is Nox in memories 2 and 3 (grey-streaked dark hair, no frost); npc_keeper_young is the girl of memory 1 and npc_keeper_mother her mother; npc_courier_m is Marten (snow to the knees); npc_north_watchkeeper is npc_innkeeper recoloured for the Thawlight Lodge.
